mapper.select:
SELECT c.cart_id, c.user_id, c.product_id, c.quantity,
p.product_name, p.price, p.image_url,
cat.category_name
FROM cart c
JOIN products p ON c.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN categories cat ON p.category_id = cat.category_id

SELECT
c.cart_id, c.user_id, c.product_id, c.quantity,
p.product_name, p.price, p.image_url,
cat.category_name
FROM cart c
JOIN products p ON c.product_id=p.product_id
JOIN categories cat ON p.category_id=cat.category_id
WHERE c.cart_id=#{cartId}

SELECT
c.cart_id, c.user_id, c.product_id, c.quantity,

SELECT
c.cart_id, c.user_id, c.product_id, c.quantity,
p.product_name, p.price, p.image_url,
cat.category_name
FROM cart c

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart (user_id, product_id, quantity) VALUES (#{userId}, #{productId}, #{quantity});
mapper.update: UPDATE cart SET quantity=#{quantity} WHERE cart_id=#{cartId}
UPDATE cart SET quantity = quantity + 1 WHERE cart_id = #{cartId}
UPDATE cart SET quantity = quantity - 1 WHERE cart_id = #{cartId} AND quantity > 1
